hero.subhead: Synthetic, oil-based liquid and biodegradable polymer beads engineered for consistent protective barriers on foliage while reducing reapplication time.

introduction.body: Mosquitoes and biting insects coincide with peak spring and early fall hunting seasons. Odin's Citronella Mosquito & Insect Repellent provides hunters with a practical, scent-smart solution. The synthetic, oil-based liquid creates a protective perimeter barrier when applied to foliage, brush, or ground cover around stands or blinds. With potential duration of up to 720 hours of continuous exposure, the formula supports reduced reapplication time compared to traditional options that last approximately 20 minutes. Formulated with a proprietary blend of plant-derived compounds including citronellal and geraniol (an EPA-registered biopesticide), it masks the CO₂, lactic acid, and octenol cues mosquitoes use to locate hosts. The milder scent profile avoids the strong chemical odors associated with DEET that deer can detect at distance. Pairs effectively with Odin's Citronella Scent Beads for layered coverage and is legal in all 50 states.

detection.headline: How Mosquitoes Locate Hosts — Three-Stage Targeting Process
detection.body: Mosquitoes use a sophisticated multi-stage system. Stage 1 (long range): CO₂ from breath detected from over 150 feet away. Stage 2 (medium range): lactic acid and octenol from skin and sweat, with output increasing during physical activity such as hiking to setups. Stage 3 (close range): body heat and moisture. Odin's Citronella disrupts Stages 1 and 2 by masking these chemical signatures through consistent vapor release from treated surfaces.

how-it-works.headline: How Citronella Liquid & Beads Work — Sustained Release Technology
how-it-works.body: The proprietary blend of citronellal, geraniol, and other plant-derived compounds masks chemical cues rather than relying on direct kill or rapid evaporation. The oil-based liquid adheres to foliage for immediate rainproof barrier performance. The complementary beads use the same biodegradable polymer technology as Odin's hunting scent products to encapsulate compounds for controlled diffusion. This delivers sustained, hands-free protection for the equivalent of 30 days of continuous exposure — not 30 minutes.

blinds.headline: Citronella in Hunting Blinds
blinds.body: Enclosed or semi-enclosed blinds concentrate the scent zone for stronger barrier performance. Hang a mesh bag of Citronella Scent Beads from the ceiling or corner while applying liquid to surrounding foliage or ground. Users report returning days or weeks later with reduced insect presence. One mesh bag can support consistent results across an entire season with minimal maintenance.

items.q: Can deer smell DEET mosquito spray?
items.a: Yes. DEET-based repellents produce a strong chemical odor detectable by deer and other game at significant distances. Citronella-based options like Odin's produce a milder, plant-derived scent that is far less likely to alert game.

items.q: Is citronella safe for skin contact?
items.a: Citronella oil is EPA-registered as a biopesticide with a non-toxic mode of action. Products are designed for deployment around your position rather than direct skin application. If hand contact occurs, the plant-derived formula washes off easily.

items.q: Does citronella repellent scare deer away while hunting?
items.a: Odin's synthetic scent and natural delivery methods use naturally occurring materials. Field observations have shown no notable concern from deer.

It masks the CO₂, lactic acid, and octenol signatures mosquitoes use to locate hosts. The biodegradable polymer technology provides continuous release — the same slow-release approach used in our hunting scent products — supporting a sustained repellent zone with reduced reapplication.

items.q: How do mosquitoes find you in the first place?
items.a: Mosquitoes detect CO₂ from breath at distances over 150 feet, lactic acid and octenol from skin and sweat, and body heat at close range. Activity increases lactic acid output, common during hunting setups.

items.q: What can I use to keep mosquitoes away while turkey hunting?
items.a: Place 2–3 tablespoons of Citronella Scent Beads in a sheer mesh bag and hang from clothing for mobile setups. For stationary positions, apply Citronella Liquid to nearby foliage to establish an additional scent barrier.

items.q: Does citronella work in a hunting blind?
items.a: It performs exceptionally well in enclosed or semi-enclosed spaces where the scent concentrates. Hang a mesh bag of beads and apply liquid to surrounding areas. Many users report returning to blinds days or weeks later with reduced insect presence.

items.q: Why do Odin's citronella beads last longer than sprays or candles?
items.a: Traditional products rely on rapid evaporation. Odin's biodegradable polymer beads encapsulate compounds for controlled diffusion, supporting sustained release equivalent to 30 days (720 hours) of continuous exposure.

items.q: How long do Odin's citronella beads last?
items.a: The beads deliver the equivalent of 30 days (720 hours) using the same polymer technology as our hunting scent products.

items.q: Can I reuse the citronella beads?
items.a: Yes. Seal the mesh bag in a Ziplock bag, roll tight, and store. Potency is preserved when not exposed to air.
